2608.27142.title: GRAIN: Bridging Name and Narrative Shifts in Real-World Graph Reasoning through Invariance-Rewarded Agentic RL
2608.27142.paper_summary: Despite their potential in standardized graph tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain brittle to real-world shifts in node identifiers and task formulation. While deterministic graph tools are invariant to such shifts, extracting topological structures from noisy text is highly fragile for LLMs, which often overfit to surface patterns. Moreover, mitigating these parsing failures via multi-agent systems incurs prohibitive latency. To address this, we propose GRAIN, a single-agent framework optimized via reinforcement learning. GRAIN models reasoning as a semantic parsing and tool-execution pipeline, guided by a Structure Invariance Reward. By validating extracted intermediate graphs against ground-truth topologies, this reward forces the LLM to learn robust text-to-structure mappings rather than memorizing linguistic artifacts. We also introduce GRIT, a benchmark evaluating sensitivity to such linguistic shifts. GRAIN outperforms multi-agent baselines by 16.45\% in accuracy with approximately 24\% lower latency. Furthermore, it demonstrates superior structural generalization, halving the out-of-distribution (OOD) gap of SFT models (from 15.77\% to 7.80\%) and maintaining robustness on large-scale graphs beyond the training distribution.
2608.27142.paper_summary_zh: 儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）在標準化圖形任務中具有潛力，但它們對於節點標識符和任務表述的現實世界變化仍然脆弱。雖然確定性圖形工具對這些變化不變，但從嘈雜文本中提取拓撲結構對於LLMs來說是非常脆弱的，這些模型往往過度擬合表面模式。此外，通過多代理系統減輕這些解析失敗會產生高昂的延遲。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了GRAIN，一個通過增強學習優化的單代理框架。GRAIN將推理建模為語義解析和工具執行管道，並由結構不變獎勵指導。通過將提取的中間圖與真實拓撲進行驗證，這一獎勵迫使LLM學習穩健的文本到結構的映射，而不是記憶語言學的文物。我們還引入了GRIT，一個評估對這種語言學變化敏感性的基準。GRAIN在準確性上比多代理基準高出16.45\%，並且延遲約低24\%。此外，它展示了卓越的結構泛化，將SFT模型的分佈外（OOD）差距減半（從15.77\%降至7.80\%），並在超越訓練分佈的大規模圖上保持穩健性。
